main_text.p: bimus prudentiæ, grauitatis, constantiæ. Om-nes tñ ferè humanitatis delectari laude videtur: neq; quisquâ liberali erectoq; est p-dit[?] ingenio, qui nō inde cōmedari cupiat. Deinde subindicandū & illud erit: neq; nos plane clarorū doctorūq; virorū indignos amori esse:reperiri in nobis, si non multa, nō tñ nulla prorsus, q̃ in sui amore homi-nes pelliceat: cuiusmodi sunt:amor, obiect[?]uantia, admiratio doctorū & magnorū vi-rorū:studiū & diligētia in capessendis arti-bus ac disciplinis:honesta laudis atq; gloriæ cupiditas, q̃ clarorū hominū coparari amore ac beneuolētia solet. Tum & q̃ hoc sit nobis honestū ac necessariū: ei vero ad quē scribim° laudabile vel etiā vtile futurū demōstrabimus. In eo deniq; totos nos fore pollicebimur: vt magnorū clarorūq; virorū nō indigni fauore videamur: obser-uātia in nobis & gratitudo debita nunquā defideretur. Sed nec τὸ ἡδύ iucūdū omittē-dū erit: propterea q̃, queadmodū agricolæ lætari solét, cū quas ipsi plantarūt arbores fructus ,pferre videntiita senes & viri clari voluptate atq; lætitia pfundūtur: cū in ca-thedra, in suggestu, in foro, in curia, in casi cellis, in aulis principū florere eos cernūt, quos amore sunt & beneuolentia cōplexi!

page.notes: The page number reads "11§" in the scan; I took it as 115 [?]. The word "p-dit" at the line end is hard to read (likely præditus), marked [?]. "obiect[?]uantia" is uncertain at the line break. The Greek "τὸ ἡδύ" is a doubtful reading of the scan. "pferre" and "pfundūtur" are as printed. The signature "h 2" is partly unclear.
